requirements: R1: The backend service must not crash during database migration initialization on startup.
R2: The backup service must mount and execute its script without directory mapping errors.

slices.title: Resolve environment startup failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to resolve the backend database migration crash and the backup script mount issue, so that the application successfully starts.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application is started via Docker Compose,
When the containers initialize,
Then the backend successfully completes database migrations and starts listening,
And the backup service script executes correctly,
And QA verification confirms the environment runs without startup errors.
